body.label: Target
body.html: One enemy within melee Weapon Range.

body.label: Effect
body.html: On success, deal 1 weapon Damage and give the target -1 on its next melee Success Die until the start of your next turn.

surges.html: An adjacent willing ally gains +1 Fortitude against the target until the start of your next turn.
Suppress 1 point of the target's ordinary attack bonuses on its next melee Action until the start of your next turn.

rider.title: Authority - Example
rider.html: Spend this Authority when the target misses a melee attack before your next turn: the intended victim may move 1 unit toward you, including yourself moving 1 unit.
